gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Noto Sans Bassa Vah reads as a plain sans with a fat midsection and a jaw-open c. Tourney sits over it with stretched, wide-tracked capitals, every stroke cut to one width, so the two feel sporty against friendly.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-batak: Noto Sans Batak reads tall and friendly, its lowercase towering like a stubby carpenter's pencil stroke. Tourney is where the pair earns its punch, since its flat, single-weight lines look best big and brief above that body.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Contemporary is the mood Noto Sans Bengali sets, with capitals barely taller than lowercase and open letter mouths. And Tourney, drawn in one unchanging line weight, would look cramped if made small, while this body would feel oversized if enlarged.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Approachable and a bit swollen, Noto Sans Bhaiksuki packs its lowercase like coiled rope. Tourney's rings of o, with a constant wall all the way round, make a bold, athletic counterweight against that softer sans.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Contemporary and cool, Noto Sans Brahmi keeps its mean line set high and leaves every curved letter open-ended. Tourney, with stems and arcs moving in lockstep, earns its keep when big and short.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Tourney is all bold, flat-lined athletic swagger, every curve held to one width without any swelling. Noto Sans Buginese sits beneath, open-mouthed and modern, like chalk arcs left unjoined.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Modern and open, Noto Sans Buhid gives curve ends generous room away from the stem. Its high-set x-height against Tourney's monoline, wide-tracked build is the pair's strongest quality, a sturdy sporty headline over a spacious, easygoing text.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-carian: Neon-tube energy meets tidy restraint. Tourney glows with one steady line thickness and bulky letters, built to announce, while Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades and simply gets on with the words.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Bent tubing is what Tourney looks like, bold and athletic and stretched wide by its tracking. Noto Sans Chakma takes over from there with lowercase packed close to the caps and uncrowded mouths on the s and c, built for reading rather than shouting.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-cham: Noto Sans Cham brings open c shapes and tall, rounded lowercase forms to the text, with plenty of entry space. Tourney's strongest quality is its pressure-free corners, where curves turn without any swell.
